To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“the transverse space of a NUT configuration in the near-horizontal region of a D = (5, 4) black hole is a cyclic lens space S3/ZN”.

the transverse space of an intersecting brane configuration in D = n + 1, with a NUT as one of its constituent components, is foliated by lens spaces in the limit where the NUT is large and the branes are close to the NUT, and that this foliation is a consequence of U-duality.

the D = 4 GPS monopole corresponds, in the decoupled limit, to a D = 5 Taub-NUT space-time, and that the D =4 black hole with a GPS monplole as one of its components corresponds, in the same limit, to a five-dimensional black hole with a Taub-Nut configuration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microscopical structure of D = 4 intersecting p-branes with Taub-NUT, and the relation between such configurations and their D = 5 analogues.
the study of intersecting p-branes in D = 10 and D = 11.
the microscopical structure of D= 4 string-theoretic black holes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in the D = 4 CFT/Ad S correspondence, the D = 5 NUT space-time plays the role of a “black-hole microscopical background.”
, in the decoupled limit, the D = 4 transverse space of a GPS monopolar black hole is the quotient of D = 5 space-time, with the D = 5 monopole removed, by the discrete symmetry group ZN.

the near-horstizon region of an extremal black hole in string theory can be obtained by a sequence of dimensional reduction, oxidation and U-duality from the near-horizone region of the black hole in the dual theory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the D = 5 NUT configuration is a non-trivial solution of the equations of motion, and it is not a solution of a dimensional reduction of a flat space-time.
the D = 5 Taub-NUT solution is a “black hole” with a horizon topology that is a lens space.
the D = 4 GPS monopole and the corresponding Taub-NUT space-time are a consequence of the Kaluaza-Klein massive modes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microscopical structure of a black-hole solution in string theory can be obtained by dimensional reduction from a corresponding solution in M-theory.
the D = 5 NUT configuration provides a simple example of the holographic correspondence in which the transverse space of a D = n black hole, in the decoupled limit, is a foliated lens space.
the D = 4 GPS monopole, which is not a BPS state, is nevertheless a natural object to study in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.
